A 2018 OTTB, Champtown Hope aka "Ranger",  Dark Bay Gelding with Chrome, 16.2 Hands who has been diagnosed with Moderate Kissing Spine, 4 spots across his whole back, and is still undergoing extensive life long non-surgical rehab. 

All rehab is being done under a rotating schedule of veterinary work: acupuncture & chiropractor, certified/licensed equine body workers, and trainer guidance for long & low and core exercises. With the help of some targeted supplements and a growth based feeding program. 

The ultimate goal is to keep Ranger pain-free, comfortable, healthy, and happy. 

Welcome to Ranger's Journey! 

Mixed in are cats, kittens, dog, and nail content.

Spice is the variety of life!
